verdict: Yes. The Healthy Binge from Pune pitched assorted baked chips on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Baked chips are popular with health-conscious buyers, but the category is crowded, so flavours and ingredients like millets or vegetables help you stand out.
angle: Baked chips, crackers and crisps appeal to office snackers and parents. Co-packers can bake in small runs. Assorted packs let buyers try several flavours and help you learn which to reorder.
